column3: “The rebellion of my complaint” is rendered “my complaint is rebellion,” and “my hand” as “His hand.” “On my groaning” is rendered “despite my groaning.”
“Who will give” is rendered “Oh that”; NASB supplies “where.” “Place” is rendered “seat.”
“Put on me” is rendered “pay attention to me.”
“From my judge” is rendered “from my Judge.”
“The way with me” is rendered “the way I take.”
“He is in one” is rendered “He is unique”; the meaning is uncertain.
“I have been destroyed” is rendered “I am … silenced”; the meaning of the verse is uncertain.
